claims.description: Supabase’s official MCP server connects AI assistants to Supabase projects for database queries, schema/migration work and other enabled developer tools. It is general development tooling, not a legal database template or a client-permission-aware legal application. Project scoping, optional read-only mode and feature selection constrain access; write tools exist outside read-only configuration. Review Supabase’s security guidance before connecting company data. Documentation reviewed on October 27, 2026; customer-account access and deployed operation have not been tested.
claims.pricing_details: Server code is open source; Supabase hosting/features, client subscriptions and operational costs are separate. Some tools create paid resources. Confirm current vendor plans.

claims.name: TimeSolv
claims.tagline: Legal time and billing software with documented third-party integrations.
claims.description: TimeSolv provides legal time tracking, invoicing, trust accounting and firm reporting. Its vendor lists integrations with billing, accounting and document services, including PointOne AI time-tracking tools. That integration does not establish native AI narrative suggestions, duplicate detection or billing-rate optimization in TimeSolv itself. Confirm the selected features and integration subscriptions with the vendor. Documentation reviewed on October 27, 2026; customer-account access and deployed operation have not been tested.
claims.pricing_details: Confirm current pricing, plan eligibility and limits with the vendor.

claims.name: US Legal MCP
claims.tagline: Community MCP research tools for US bills, regulations and court opinions.
claims.description: The JamesANZ repository documents a community MCP server for Congress bills and committees, Federal Register documents, CourtListener opinions and selected curated legislative references. The maintainer describes optional API keys and additional source/filtering features. Confirm current upstream access and coverage, and read original source material before using results in legal work; a connector is not a guarantee of complete or accurate research. Documentation reviewed on October 27, 2026; customer-account access and deployed operation have not been tested.
claims.pricing_details: MIT-licensed server software. Hosting, optional filtering services and upstream API terms or limits are separate.

claims.name: Vincent by Clio
claims.tagline: AI-assisted legal research, analysis and configurable legal workflows.
claims.description: Vincent by Clio is the legal AI product presented on vLex's site. The vendor describes cited legal research, jurisdiction comparisons, complaint and contract analysis, and Vincent Studio for custom no-code workflows. Studio is described for large law firms and enterprise legal teams. Confirm jurisdictional coverage, workflow availability and subscription terms with Clio. Outputs require qualified review. Documentation reviewed on October 29, 2026; customer-account access and deployed operation have not been tested.
claims.pricing_details: Official pages offer a demo and free trial. No subscription price or trial duration is stated on the reviewed product, trial or demo pages; confirm current pricing, plan eligibility and trial conditions with Clio.
